patchNotes:
DC: Dark Legion is updating today, May 22! Check out the patch notes below:
Reminder: Dev plans are always subject to change. Watch your in-game announcements for the most accurate information. Changes related to your feedback are marked with :neonsparkles:

:Titans:  New Themed Event: Teen Titan's Summer Smash (Available on May 24. Requires War Room Lv. 10) :Titans:
Teen Titan's Summer Smash is here. Mento's experimental arcade is more than just a game—it sharpens reflexes and strategy with every run. Join the Titans in fast-paced training, earn rewards, and celebrate with team-favorite treats along the way.

Titan's Reflex Training
Pull back the spring to launch marbles. As they bounce down and land in the landing slots, you'll earn the listed Titan Tokens.
Titan Tokens can be exchanged for valuable items in the [Pizza Corner].

Cyborg's Assistance
Submit Soder Cola to Cyborg to:
Unlock milestone rewards.
Unlock and upgrade the System Hack skill, which replaces bumper rewards when cast.

Pizza Celebration
During the event, earn Titan's Favorite Pizzas through the following methods:
Complete daily tasks, or initiate and win Coordinated Assaults against the Dark Legion (guaranteed)
Crisis Response and Anti-Crime Network (chance to obtain)
Send gifts to friends or league members, and both of you will receive Party Pizza Boxes, which may contain Marbles, Soder Cola, and other event items.
Join the Summer Smash and win the Titans Tower Base skin, Summer Smash Frame, Magic Eyes, World Anvil Fragments, and other rare rewards!

:PlanetCoins: New Official Web Store Event: Limited-Time Rewards (Available on May 24) :PlanetCoins:
During the event, purchases made in the official web store or the Champion Zone earn you points, which can be redeemed for amazing rewards in the store. For details, check the [Champion Zone]. (The Champion Zone is currently unavailable on PC. Please use the official web store or access it via the mobile version.)

:Dab: Improvements: Guardian Challenge :Dab: :neonsparkles:
Updated Guardian Challenge point rules.

:batman_yes: Point Rule Adjustments: Guardian Challenge, Great Krypton Rush, Battle for Gotham, and Ultimate Battle for Gotham :batman_yes:
Points are now awarded proportionally based on the amount of enemy Stamina each player depletes, rather than enemy Power.

🆙  Improvements 🆙
Adjusted certain milestone rewards for Fierce Onslaught and Training Simulator.
Added cross-server infiltration to Expedition: players can now infiltrate Expedition missions from other servers. :neonsparkles:
Added a coordinates feature to the world map: players can now save and share coordinates, as well as search for locations by coordinates. :neonsparkles:
Improved the sorting and display on the Champions screen.
Improved how available resources are displayed in scout reports.

🛠️  Fixes 🛠️
Fixed various text and display issues.
